stem: A room sensor reads 78°F and 55% RH, but a second verified sensor beside it reads 74°F and 63% RH. What should the technician do first?
choices: Average the two values and record only the average
Check placement, timestamp, verification status, and obvious sensor issues before deciding which reading represents the crop
Change the room setpoint until both sensors match
Ignore both readings and use the building thermostat
rationale: Conflicting sensors should be investigated for placement, timing, and measurement quality before operational changes are made.
